intro: Converting joules (J) to kilowatt-hours (kWh) is essential when translating measurements across household electricity billing, HVAC thermal sizing, battery storage capacity, and dietary energy analysis. One joule equals 2.777778e-7 kilowatt-hours, while one kilowatt-hour equals 3,600,000 joules. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many kilowatt-hours are in 1 joule?
faqs.answer: There are 2.777778e-7 kilowatt-hours (kWh) in 1 joule (J). To convert J to kWh, use the exact conversion factor 2.777778e-7.

faqs.question: How do I convert joules to kilowatt-hours manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your joule value by 2.777778e-7 (exact factor: 2.777778e-7). For example, 250 J × 2.777778e-7 = 0.00006944 kWh.
